Dear Sir/Madam,

Re: Unreliable Power Supply in Chingola

I am writing to express my frustration and disappointment with the inconsistent power supply in Chingola, which has been ongoing for several weeks now. Despite the 8-hour load shedding schedule implemented by Zesco, we have been experiencing unpredictable and extended power outages in our area.

Specifically,started on 10th April 2024, The power went out at 06:10 and was only restored at 14:00, only to go out again at 19:00 and remain off until now. This erratic pattern has been the norm for the past few weeks, causing significant inconvenience and disruption to our daily lives.

As a customer, I expect a reliable and consistent power supply, especially considering the 8-hour load shedding schedule that was put in place to manage power distribution. The current situation is unacceptable and has resulted in food spoilage, disrupted work and study schedules, and additional expenses for alternative power sources.

I urge you to investigate this matter and take immediate action to address the issue. Please ensure that your team sticks to the scheduled load shedding times and works to minimize unscheduled outages.

I appreciate your prompt attention to this matter, and I look forward to a more reliable power supply in the near future.

Sincerely,
